uncited: If `mode == 'normal'`: set `net_image = rend_normal`, then normalize from $[-1, 1]$ to $[0, 1]$ via `net_image = (net_image + 1) / 2`.
If `mode == 'edge'`: set `net_image = render`, then apply `gradient_map` to `net_image`.
If `mode == 'curvature'`: set `net_image = rend_normal`, normalize to $[0, 1]$, then apply `gradient_map`.
If `net_image` has a single channel (`shape[0] == 1`), apply `colormap` to `net_image`.
